item.text: {"category_edits":[{"category":"sequence_modeling","rationale":"Shorten causal context to floor(0.75 × current length), with a minimum of one interaction (128 → 96 by default). Existing truncation retains recent interactions chronologically, and saved maxlen metadata applies the same context during prediction. This may reduce stale-interest interference and recurrent computation while preserving the GRU architecture, readout, loss and optimizer.","edits":[{"find":"MAXLEN        = int(os.environ.get(\"GRU4REC_MAXLEN\", \"128\"))","replace":"MAXLEN        = max(1, (3 * int(os.environ.get(\"GRU4REC_MAXLEN\", \"128\"))) // 4)"}]}],"change_summary":"Reduce training and prediction context length by 25% across all four datasets through the existing shared maxlen and predictor metadata."}
